name: NICW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Falcon held it three times before losing it to first-time challenger "Masta Ace" Mike D'Angelo in a thirty-minute Ironman main event at NICW's own Wrestlefest supercard.

name: NICW Transcontinental Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles title carried by the fed's own 1999 revival, first attested held by Dr. Hate in the promotion's own 21 April 1999 rankings bulletin.

name: NICW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own 1999 revival tag championship, first attested held by the Hall Brothers, undefeated at 4-0-0 in the promotion's own 21 April 1999 rankings bulletin.
